enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Fold arms. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face.
Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and spoon. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag with stethoscope and notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out scrubs. Put on scrubs. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out stethoscope. Place stethoscope in bag. Take notes from desk. Place notes in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Write notes. Discuss treatment. Exit room. See next patient. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Complete paperwork.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Splash water on face. Dry hands with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up dishes and wiping the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Take sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch more TV. Change channel again. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reviewing notes on the computer and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open notes file. Read notes. Highlight important points. Close file. Shut down computer. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Read book. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Fold arms. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
